The assumptions bullets landed at the end of the file instead of under `## Assumptions`. Fixing placement:

{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PY'
import io
p='specs/001-transactions/spec.md'
s=io.open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
bullets=("- Idempotency tokens are per batch writer instance: two different writer instances over the same database do not share token state, and no token data is written into user documents or storage.\n"
"- Token comparison of \"identical operations\" is based on the full structural content of the submitted operation list (all fields, including any that would be rejected as unsupported); a batch that failed validation is not recorded, so its token remains free.\n"
"- The token parameter is exclusive to `apply`; `preview` keeps its original signature and never touches token state.\n")
assert s.endswith(bullets), 'bullets not at end'
s=s[:-len(bullets)]
anchor='## Conflicting Evidence - Resolved'
assert anchor in s
s=s.replace(anchor, bullets+anchor,1)
io.open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s)
print('fixed, len',len(s))
PY
grep -n "^###\|^##" /testbed/specs/001-transactions/spec.md"}
